description: This file defines the CalendarProviderRegistry class responsible for discovering, loading, managing, and providing calendar provider types and instances within the SuiteCRM application. It handles provider registration from configuration files, caching, and extension integration.

classes.name: CalendarProviderRegistry
classes.description: Manages calendar provider types, discovers providers from configuration files, caches provider data, writes extension language files, and provides provider instances for calendar accounts.

methods.name: loadProviders
methods.description: Loads provider definitions, using cache if available, otherwise discovers providers.

methods.name: discoverProviders
methods.description: Discovers and registers calendar providers from PHP configuration files in specific directories.

methods.name: writeCalendarSourceTypesToExtension
methods.description: Writes calendar source types to language extension files for customization and localization.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled calendar source types for UI elements.

methods.name: findEnabled
methods.description: Filters and returns only enabled provider types.

methods.name: getProviderForAccount
methods.description: Returns a calendar provider instance for a given calendar account.

methods.name: findBySource
methods.description: Finds a provider type by its source identifier if enabled.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a provider source exists.

methods.name: getInternalProviderForAccount
methods.description: Provides an internal SuiteCRM calendar provider for a given account.

methods.name: getAuthMethodForSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method for a specific provider source.
